title: Nine Pounds and Nine Bridges
subtitle: 业余与专业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 业余与专业（文学艺术与体育·竞技与参与）
meta: 主题语境：业余与专业（文学艺术与体育·竞技与参与）　|　核心词汇：amateur　|　正文 315 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 amateur 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1958 my uncle ran nine miles in fifty-one minutes and was still an ① amateur, which meant he was not paid and was not allowed to be, and he said the word has never meant what people think. He was ② an amateur photographer too, and my grandmother said a man with two hobbies has one life and no job; an amateur, he said, is somebody who has not yet been paid to stop.

The ③ amateur race at the fair, which he won five times, was nine minutes long and had no prize. My father said an ④ amateur is a person who does a thing for love and a professional is a person who does it for money, and my uncle said the difference is that one of them is allowed to stop.

He lost his ⑤ amateur status in 1964 by accepting nine pounds, and he said the nine pounds were the only money he had ever been ashamed of. There was ⑥ amateur dramatics in the village hall every winter, and my mother said the word in front of a play is a warning and not a description.

The ⑦ amateur, meaning him and not the money, kept running until 1979 and then stopped and never explained. Every ⑧ amateur painter in the county painted the same nine bridges, and my grandmother said an amateur is somebody who has decided not to be told, and that this is either the best or the worst thing about them.

The ⑨ amateur I would name, if I named one, is not the runner but the man with the camera, who took nine hundred photographs and got four right. An ⑩ amateur, he told me in 1988, is the only person in a race who is running against the distance and not against the other man; every amateur, he said, finishes twice, and that is why they are the only ones anybody remembers.

answers.why: amateur 意为“业余选手、业余运动员”，1958 年他九英里跑了五十一分钟却仍是业余选手：不拿钱，也不许拿。
an amateur photographer 意为“业余摄影爱好者”，他同时还是个业余摄影爱好者。
amateur 作形容词，意为“业余的、非职业的”，集市上的业余赛跑他赢过五次，全程九分钟，没有奖品。
amateur 与 professional 对举，意为“业余者与职业者”，父亲说业余者是出于热爱做事的人，职业者是为钱做事的人。
amateur status 意为“业余身份”，1964 年他因为收下九英镑而失去了业余身份。
amateur dramatics 意为“业余戏剧表演”，每年冬天村礼堂都有业余戏剧演出。
amateur 意为“业余爱好者”，那个业余爱好者——指的是他本人而不是那笔钱——一直跑到 1979 年。
amateur 作形容词，意为“业余爱好的、非专业的”，全县每一个业余画家画的都是同样的九座桥。
amateur 意为“外行、生手”，我要点名的那个外行不是跑者，而是拿相机的人：拍了九百张，只有四张是对的。
amateur 意为“业余选手”，他说业余选手是赛跑中唯一与时间赛跑、而不是与人赛跑的人。
